//: Stryker.NET. Copy to the test project root, or the solution root and use --project. Run scoped: dotnet stryker --mutate "src/Co.Domain/Pricing/**"

stryker-config.//thresholds: break is the only one that fails CI. Set it to what you actually achieve on a critical module, minus a small margin — an aspirational number just gets lowered.
stryker-config.//mutate: Scope every run. Whole-solution mutation takes hours and gets disabled.
stryker-config.//ignore-mutations: Mutations that produce noise rather than signal in this codebase.
stryker-config.//ignore-methods: Guard clauses and logging: mutating these produces survivors nobody will ever act on.
stryker-config.//since: On a PR, mutate only what changed against the base branch.
